prompts.torch: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an isolated transparent-background sprite derived from the wall torches in the supplied dungeon mockup. The reference is the art style and torch design reference; do not reproduce the scene or UI. One compact warm ORANGE wall-mounted torch/sconce, centered alone with transparent padding. Thick dark blue-black iron mounting plate, short stout support, shallow rounded bowl with a clearly readable thick rim, broad lively orange flame with yellow core. Painted cartoon fantasy mobile game asset, rounded facets, bold dark outer silhouette, 3 or 4 broad value groups, minimal texture. It must read beautifully at about 64 pixels total displayed height and 30 pixels width, not just enlarged. Match the mockup's near-front view with slight visible bowl top; no isometric ground base. Flame roughly half total height. The attachment at the bottom must look fastened into a wall, with an understated contact shadow very close to the plate. Small warm reflection on rim. Genuine transparent alpha outside the object, no wall rectangle, no floor, no large bloom halo, no text, no particles, no hairline etchings, no ornate tiny detail, no photorealism. Keep the complete object uncropped.
prompts.crystal: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an isolated transparent-background decoration sprite matching the supplied painted cartoon dungeon mockup. The supplied image is the art style, dark blue slate palette and purple accent reference only. One compact luminous violet crystal EMBEDDED IN a small irregular dark blue slate socket for attachment to a vertical dungeon wall. Main crystal is a short broad elongated diamond with 3-4 big readable facets, pale violet core and rich purple edges; no long spires. Around it, a very narrow chipped stone lip with 4-5 chunky asymmetric facets, recessed dark contact seam, subtle purple reflected light on inner stone. Crystal visibly sunk into stone and flush at its base; no floating jewel or separate medallion. Stone surround quiet blue slate like the mockup, with a softly irregular outer edge, no rectangular tile. Cartoon painted fantasy, large simple shapes and dark contour, reads at about 38 pixels displayed height. Front-facing facade decoration, no isometric ground pedestal. Genuine transparent background, whole object centered with padding, no scene, no UI, no text, no symbols, no gold, no flourishes, no microdetail, no branching neon Y crack, no big glow cloud, no photorealistic mineral. Preserve the full native alpha.
